url.title: What is the history of India?
url.p: The history of India is characterized by great diversity of geography, language, and culture. Ancient India was a land of many kingdoms and empires, each with its own distinct culture and history.

url.title: What is the significance of the Indus Valley Civilization?
url.p: The Indus Valley Civilization was one of the world's earliest urban civilizations, known for its advanced architecture, drainage systems, and trade networks.
